user_goal: Fix Plotkeeper scanning, reviewer output buffering and mismatched copies on an isolated copy; provide a tested installer, public agent repair guidance and a reviewed PR. Do not launch LP or alter the live installation.

authority.verbatim_text:
Yep, fix Plotkeeper’s scanning, output buffering and mismatched copies. Work on a copy and QA it first - lmk when the installer is ready.

If you update plotkeeper, make sure to update the repo as well, as ya know, other people might be using this LOL  make it so that an agent that installs it knows what to remove in case the old shit is still present on their side too.  Just imagine other public people are using that git repo lol and their agents are doing the same thing you are - how would you want to be told to fix it or how would you put into the plotkeeper code something to prevent it from happening and help other agents locate and solve issues within it!

open a PR and merge/close when coderabbit reviews and says no more critical/major issues

Include the existing deployed fixes
